source_text: Each new pilot has an ir_forbid for the catalog look-alikes: a uniform population, a cautious or low-stakes generalization, or a selection-not-size doubt; a causal chain whose links are each given a mechanism, or line-drawing with no prediction; options that are not claimed to be the only ones, or a true dichotomy; expert agreement, a question about taste or popularity itself, popularity as one piece among others, or a non-decisive hedge; association offered only as disclosure or caution, or merits that are actually engaged. A slippery chain with no stated leap is at most possible issue (catalog outside-text condition on whether each later step is likely). A “probably” hedge does not fill that gap. Hedge, default_rule, and precautionary mappings stay as in the extractor prompt.
